Mass 2.625 (2.579 to 2.665) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 661291136701346304: teff_gspphot 7873.0146 K (16th-84th percentiles 7870.888-7875.3013), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
